description: Search Odysee videos by keyword, export a channel's uploads, browse a tag, or fetch details for specific video URLs.

channel.description: Used by mode=byChannel. Accepts an @handle (@veritasium), an Odysee channel URL, an lbry:// channel URL, or a channel claim ID.
channel.title: Channel

includeStats.description: Add view count, likes, dislikes and channel follower count. These numbers come from Odysee's public counters and add a few small requests per record.
includeStats.title: Include engagement stats

keyword.description: Keyword used by mode=search. Supports ordinary words and non-English text. Odysee returns at most about 550 results per keyword.
keyword.title: Search keyword

maxItems.description: Maximum number of records to collect across the whole run.
maxItems.title: Max items

mediaType.description: Filter channel, tag and keyword results by Odysee stream type. Details mode returns the referenced item as-is.
mediaType.title: Media type

mode.description: Choose what to collect: a keyword search, a channel's uploads, a tag feed, or details for specific videos.
mode.title: Mode

orderBy.description: Sort order for channel and tag modes. Keyword search always uses Odysee's relevance ranking.
orderBy.title: Sort order

tag.description: Used by mode=byTag. Tag text without the leading #, for example science, technology or gaming.
tag.title: Tag

videoUrls.description: Used by mode=details. One item per line: a full Odysee video URL, an lbry:// URL, or a 40-character claim ID.
videoUrls.title: Video URLs or claim IDs

title: Odysee Scraper Input
